'Prior authorization for advanced imaging (MRI, CT, PET) is valid for 45 days from the date of insurer approval. If the scheduled exam date falls outside that 45-day window, staff must request a new authorization before booking; the exam cannot be scheduled on the expired authorization number. Re-authorization typically takes 5-10 business days once submitted, so patients should be advised of this delay if their original window has lapsed. Expedited re-authorization (48-72 hours) is available only for cases flagged as urgent by the ordering physician. Staff should always check the original approval date against the proposed exam date before booking, even if the patient believes their authorization is still current, since patients are not always aware of this window.'
